source.title: Catalogue of the Aramaic and Mandaic Incantation Bowls in the British Museum
source.authors: J. B. Segal, with a contribution by Erica C. D. Hunter
source.citation: Segal, J. B., with Erica C. D. Hunter. Catalogue of the Aramaic and Mandaic Incantation Bowls in the British Museum. London: British Museum Press, 2000.
source.notes: The table of contents enumerates text numbers 001A–142Ps. The British Museum bibliography page reports 159 related collection objects.

summary: British Museum incantation bowl text catalogued by Segal (2000); registration-number reconciliation pending.

leads.description: Reconcile all 142 Segal text numbers to British Museum registration and museum numbers using the catalogue concordance and current collection pages.
Identify and account for the difference between the 142 numbered texts and the 159 objects currently related to Segal 2000 on the British Museum site.
Obtain authorized access to the complete Segal 2000 catalogue; the openly indexed PDF located during discovery is only a two-page title/contents preview.
